newsitem.title: POLAND: GM UNIT TAKES FULL STAKE IN POLISH PLANT.
newsitem.headline: GM UNIT TAKES FULL STAKE IN POLISH PLANT.

text.p: A unit of General Motors Corp upped to a full stake its one-percent share of Polish radiator and heating systems maker Delphi Harrison Thermal Systems sp zoo, PAP news agency reported late on Friday.
PAP did not disclose the amount of the purchase of the plant based in the central Polish province of Kalisz, which represented the state treasury in the deal.

Delphi sp zoo formed last month when in a joint-venture deal GM's New-York-State-based unit Delphi Harrison Thermal Systems took one percent of the state-owned Zaklady Sprzetu Mechanicznego (ZSM) machinery plant in the Kalisz town of Ostrow Wielkopolski.
ZSM employs 900 and is the largest Polish producer of radiators and heating systems for cars and portable gas heaters.
Delphi sp zoo President Janusz Wojtowicz said the plant produced for the Polish subsidiaries of South Korea's Daewoo and Italy's Fiat .
"We will continue to export to Germany, Britain, Italy, Ireland, Slovakia, Sweden and New Zealand," PAP quoted Wojtowicz as saying.
